name: eng-project-governance
summary: Owns canonical work-item, milestone, candidate, release-window, pipeline-gate, and closure decisions.
input_contract: Raw intake or work-item reference, one system of record, artifact revisions, AC, dependencies, project profile, and write or release authority.
output_contract: Owned project handoff slice plus canonical WorkItem decisions, milestones, selected candidates, gates, status, conflicts, and next owner.
